summary: Content that scrolls inside whatever holds it, with a thin scrollbar that shows while you hover or scroll.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the focus outline. Inherits the nearest `Shape`; under `pill`, `rounded`.

props.name: animated
props.description: The scrollbar fading in while you hover or scroll. Turn it off for a scrollbar that is simply there, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the area. Its height lives here: `merge` folds them in last, so `h:96` replaces the default `h:72`.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
